verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a documented CLI tool, so it runs headlessly by nature. Its documented commands fit automation pipelines: `tofu plan` with `-out=FILE` saves a plan that `tofu apply` can execute later, speculative plans support pre-code-review checks, and `tofu test` creates and destroys real infrastructure to verify assertions. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation (non-interactive or auto-approve flags, machine-readable output, CI pipeline guides) and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
